brand.name: Yarrow & Broom Cleaning Co.
brand.tagline: A house that feels like a fresh start.

owner.name: Nell Prescott
owner.heading: The person who sets your checklist
owner.bio: Nell Prescott started cleaning houses between shifts at a diner on American Legion Boulevard, and kept doing it because she liked the part where somebody walks in the door and exhales. Yarrow & Broom grew out of that — a small crew that shows up on the same weekday, works from a checklist the household actually wrote, and would rather quote a fair flat price than pad an hourly clock. Nell still walks every new house herself before a price is given.

contact.hours: Cleaning Monday to Friday, 8am to 5pm · Saturdays by request

faq.q: How long does a visit take?
faq.a: A standard clean on a three-bedroom house usually runs a morning with two cleaners. The price does not move with the clock, though — you agreed to a flat number before we started, and that is the number.

faq.q: Do I need to be home?
faq.a: No. Most clients leave a key, a lockbox or a door code and come home to it done. If you would rather be there the first time, that is completely normal and we will book it that way.

faq.q: What should I do before you arrive?
faq.a: Nothing you would dread. Clearing counters and floors of the personal things you would not want moved helps us spend the visit cleaning instead of sorting, but we work around whatever is there.

Yes — cloths, machines and products all come with the crew. If your household needs a specific product or wants something left off the shelf entirely, tell us at the walkthrough and it goes on your checklist.

faq.q: Is the deep clean really required first?
faq.a: For a recurring plan, yes. The recurring rate assumes the house starts from a reset; without it the first visits cost more than they should and never quite catch up. One-off standard cleans do not need it.

faq.q: How do I pay, and can I cancel?
faq.a: Card or cash after each visit. There is no contract and no cancellation fee — a text the day before is plenty, and the slot goes back on the board.

hero.title: Come home to a house that has already been handled.
hero.subtitle: Yarrow & Broom cleans houses and apartments across Mountain Home and Elmore County. A flat price per visit, agreed before we start, and the same crew on the same weekday.

about.heading: A standing appointment, not a favor you have to chase
about.body: Most people do not want a cleaning service so much as they want one evening a week back. So we run this like a standing appointment: a set weekday, a set crew, a checklist your household wrote, and a price that was settled at the walkthrough instead of at the door. If something is not right, you tell us and it is on the list from then on — that is the whole arrangement.

howItWorks.title: Walk the house
howItWorks.desc: We come see the place first, room by room, and ask what actually bothers you. The walkthrough is free and there is nothing to sign at the end of it.

howItWorks.title: Get a flat price
howItWorks.desc: You get the per-visit number in writing before anything starts — set by the rooms and the cadence you pick, never by how long the day happens to run.

howItWorks.title: We clean, you carry on
howItWorks.desc: Same crew, same weekday. Leave a key or a door code; most households are at work while we work and walk into it finished.

howItWorks.title: Tell us what to shift
howItWorks.desc: After a visit we ask what to do more of. Your checklist changes that day and stays changed, so the fourth visit fits better than the first.

promises.title: Flat per-visit price
promises.blurb: Agreed at the walkthrough, in writing, before a cloth comes out.

promises.title: The same crew
promises.blurb: The people who learned your house are the people who come back.

promises.title: Your checklist
promises.blurb: Written by your household, adjusted whenever you say so.

promises.title: No contract
promises.blurb: Pause, move or stop a visit with a text the day before.

niche.pricingNote: Most homes land between $129–$289 a visit. Whatever the number is, it is set before we start — nothing gets added on afterwards, and there is no charge for driving out to look.

beforeAfter.heading: The same corner, one visit apart
beforeAfter.blurb: Drag the handle. This is an ordinary Friday clean in an ordinary rented flat — floor cleared, laundry racked, the room handed back usable.

niche.areaNote: Out past Hammett or down toward Bruneau? Call and ask — the route reaches further some weeks than others, and we would rather tell you straight than take a booking we cannot keep.
